summary: Accordion whose pixel plus signs fold into minus signs while the panels open smoothly; one or several items can stay open.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled list of open items (their `value`, or `title`). Use with `onValueChange`.

props.name: items
props.description: The sections: `{ value?: string; title: string; summary?: string; content: React.ReactNode }`. `value` defaults to `title`; `summary` adds muted text at the end of the header.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Lets several items stay open; without it, opening one closes the others.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the open items whenever the user opens or closes one.

keyboard.action: Open or close the focused item.
Move focus to the next / previous header, wrapping.
Move focus to the first / last header.

accessibility: Each header is a native button with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, inside an `<h3>`.
Each panel has `role="region"` and is labelled by its header through `aria-labelledby`.
Closed panels are `inert`, so their content leaves the tab order and the accessibility tree; the closing animation still plays.
The plus and minus icon is an `aria-hidden` canvas.
motion: With reduced motion panels open and close without the height and fade transitions, and the plus and minus icon switches at once.
notes: Panels stay mounted while closed, so their content keeps its state.
Each item's `value` (or its `title` when `value` is not set) must be unique within the accordion.

items.title: What is Ultracode?
items.content: A mode that sends xhigh effort and lets the agent plan multi-agent workflows on its own.

items.title: How is usage counted?
items.content: Usage resets weekly. Longer reasoning and more agents use more of it.

items.title: Can I export my data?
items.content: Yes. Settings has an export that includes chats, projects and files.
